name: cod-ab-mys
notes:
Malaysia administrative level 0-2 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01.  
  
This dataset is structured into 2 levels:  
- Admin 1: 16 nan  
- Admin 2: 144 nan  
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 30 October 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 11 February 2021: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 01 January 2021: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 01 January 2021: boundaries created by the source  
  
Contributed by [OCHA Regional Office for Asia and the Pacific (ROAP)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-roap).  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).
